authority: Submitted v2 A1-A4 and D2; bounded acceptance v1
scope: Verify inputs; manual 2021 fitting and 2022 A2 gates only. This is not a final scientific freeze or complete A3 protocol.

roles.2023: exposed validation later, no automatic retuning

calendar: UTC elapsed seconds/current UTC year length; fractional UTC hour/24; 13 features in scientific_models.FEATURES order. Source-date roles/months precede HH24 conversion.
solver: NumPy 2.3.5 float64 column-normalised SVD lstsq; rank cutoff eps*max(n,p); transform coefficients back; no normal equations, regularisation or refit
residual: y-prediction; frozen 2021 arithmetic mean and sample SD with n-1; finite strictly positive SD required, no added scientific epsilon threshold
eligibility: Unique finite target; P additionally same-time same-variable unique finite Schiphol; explicit unavailable reasons. Empty reviewed early numeric exclusion mask, assumed-normal not certified.
undefined_common_ratio: Zero S RMSE or no common rows cannot establish the required comparative gate; retain S only if eligible. No tolerance changes gate decisions.
failure: Full-rank S comparator failure or neither eligible => revision_required, no calibration/default settings

A3_pending.cutoff: one-based ceil((1-alpha)*n), n>0, finite c>0; strict exceedance
A3_pending.ranking: maximum paired detected fraction; minimum mean normalised delay with unavailable/miss penalty 1; larger lambda exact tie; all-zero fails
A3_pending.context_gate: Specify and verify strictly earlier context for continuous calibration before executing A3. Starting cold on 1 January loses 227 updates and cannot meet January's 90% ready coverage; do not bypass or reset monthly.
A3_pending.state: first ready update 228; hold through 6 unavailable hours; reset at 7; P gaps never switch to S
A3_pending.validation: 2023 unchanged transfer; annual FPR >.01 or monthly >.03 prompts diagnosis/disclosure, not automatic retuning

preserved_design: B0/R/H; all seven families, 78 monthly variants, 936 annual cases; primary plus alpha .005/.02 and T range [-30,45] sensitivities
numeric_verification: Hand fixture coefficient tolerance 1e-10; no tolerance for gate/threshold decisions. Same-environment repeats must match scientific JSON values exactly; no cross-platform equality claimed.
resources: Sequential, numerical thread limits 1; stage preflight 256 MiB available RAM and 1 GiB free disk are operational allowances, not full-batch capacity guarantees
launch: Researcher launches lengthy work. fit-gates is a bounded early-stage command, prepared but not run on real observations in this increment.
limitations: No healthy-reference certification, no scientific freeze, no final intake, no complete calibration/ranking, no detector integration. Assistance: Codex.
